decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed for actual backpacks, excluding accessories like cleaning kits and hydration bladders, as well as unrelated items like sleeping pads and chairs. In my consideration set, I included a range of types: a 45L tactical pack, a 70L heavy-duty internal frame pack, an ultra-lightweight packable daypack, a 37L mid-size hiking pack, and a specialized cooler backpack. My final choice is the QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057). It holds an impressive 4.7 rating with over 6,000 reviews, indicating high consumer satisfaction and durability. At $39.99, it offers superior value and organizational features (Molle system, 45L capacity) compared to the more expensive Seibertron or Mardingtop options.
